bitcoin_articles.headline: Jefferies Highlights Riot Platforms' AI Data Center Capabilities in New Research
bitcoin_articles.summary: Jefferies analysts identified Riot Platforms as a key player in the conversion of Bitcoin mining power footprints into AI data center infrastructure.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Sequans Completes Full Redemption of Convertible Debt
bitcoin_articles.summary: Sequans Communications S.A. has fully redeemed its remaining convertible debt issued in July 2025, utilizing proceeds from the sale of a portion of its Bitcoin holdings.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Fold Secures $150 Million Credit Facility to Scale Bitcoin Rewards Credit Card
bitcoin_articles.summary: Fold Holdings, Inc. has entered into a four-year, $150 million senior secured revolving credit facility with Encina Lender Finance to support the growth of its Bitcoin rewards credit card program.

bitcoin_articles.headline: CME Group Expands Bitcoin Futures and Options to 24/7 Trading
bitcoin_articles.summary: CME Group has transitioned its Bitcoin futures and options contracts to a 24/7 trading schedule on the Globex platform, effective May 29, 2026.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Genius Group Announces Expansion of Treasury Strategy with New AGI Infinity Portfolio
bitcoin_articles.summary: Genius Group Limited has approved the expansion of its treasury strategy to include a dual Bitcoin and AI Treasury, launching the new AGI Infinity Portfolio.
